title: Define the trace format and refuse malformed traces
problem: Every later check reads traces. If a trace can omit a tool result, reorder steps or lose its termination reason, the checks will pass or fail for reasons that have nothing to do with the agent.
context: This is the first task of a learner-authored forge project. No source exists yet. The learner creates the repository, chooses its structure, and owns every design decision inside the specification's constraints.
impact: The trace is the only evidence of what the agent did. A loose format makes every judgment built on it unreliable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A trace records ordered steps, each with the tool requested, its arguments, and either a result or an error, plus the scenario ID and a termination reason. The format is declared in data or a documented schema.
A trace with a result that has no matching call, out-of-order steps, a missing termination reason, or an unknown field is refused. The error names the step and what is wrong.
A valid trace written and read back is identical.
Automated tests cover one valid trace and at least three distinct malformed ones, and pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains why each field exists, one field considered and rejected, and what breaks first if a denied tool call is recorded the same way as a successful one.

constraints: Standard library plus a test runner only.
No network access and no model API. Every input is synthetic and generated or checked in by the learner.
Do not implement the agent loop or any checks yet. This task ends at a validated trace format.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: One data format, its validation and serialization.

investigation_areas: What a reader must be able to reconstruct from a trace alone
How a denied call, an erroring call and an unknown tool differ in the record
Which malformations would silently change a check's verdict
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design; the learner chooses the runner and the layout.
documentation_requirements: Record the trace format, its invariants and the rejected alternative in the learner design.

next_task_preview.title: Build a bounded agent loop and check each trace
next_task_preview.summary: A deterministic loop with a tool registry, step budget and termination, and per-trace checks for success, budget and forbidden attempts.
